hero.headline: GIS, MAPPING & REMOTE SENSING
hero.title: Survey Smarter, Build Stronger
hero.description: Leading Africa's Land and Aerial Surveying Revolution. SmartGrid Surveying provides precise GIS and remote sensing services — from UAV photogrammetry, LiDAR mapping, to multispectral analysis and DEM creation.

whatIsGis.headline: Geographic Information Systems (GIS)
whatIsGis.description: At Smartgrid Surveying, we use GIS technology to bring data to life. By combining geographic science with cutting-edge mapping tools, we transform layers of data into actionable insights that power smarter decisions for governments, businesses, and communities across Africa and beyond. GIS (Geographic Information Systems) is a powerful technology that links location data with attributes, allowing users to visualize, analyze, and interpret spatial relationships. From urban planning to agriculture, GIS empowers you to see the bigger picture — and all the critical details.

remoteSensingSolutions.headline: Remote Sensing Solutions
remoteSensingSolutions.description: SmartGrid Surveying provides precise GIS and remote sensing services — from UAV photogrammetry, LiDAR mapping, to multispectral analysis and DEM creation. We deliver accurate spatial data to support planning, engineering, and environmental projects across Kenya and Africa.

items.title: Multispectral Analysis
items.description: Capture data across multiple spectral bands for agriculture, vegetation health, and environmental monitoring.

items.title: Feature Extraction
items.description: Identify and digitize geographic features such as buildings, roads, water bodies, and land cover from imagery.

items.title: Volumetric Calculations
items.description: Compute volumes of stockpiles, cut/fill operations, and resource deposits with high precision.

items.title: Land Use/Land Cover
items.description: Classify and map land use categories and land cover types for planning and environmental management.
